metaTitle: Custom Tran Bath Hand Towels | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom Tran bath hand towels for your business. Perfect for spas, gyms, and hotels. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Tran bath hand towels offer a versatile blank for your custom branding, whether you need plush hemmed towels for a luxury spa or quick-dry sports towels for a fitness center. These towels accept screen printing, embroidery, and heat transfer with excellent color retention. Choose from velour, terry, or microfiber options to match your facility's needs. Bulk orders ensure consistent quality across all units.
heroAltText: Custom Tran bath hand towels with embroidered logo, available in white and assorted colors for spa and gym use.
